convert_fairseq_s2t_checkpoint: convert a fairseq Speech2Text checkpoint to a HuggingFace transformers model
rename_keys_state_dict: rename fairseq state dict keys mapping transformer_layers to layers and subsample to conv
remove_ignore_keys_state_dict: remove ignored keys like version strings and _float_tensor from a fairseq state dict
make_linear_from_emb: create a Linear layer from an embedding layer with matching vocab and embed dimensions
run_cli_convert: run the CLI script to convert a fairseq .pt checkpoint to a PyTorch dump folder path
